newsitem.title: USA: Response USA settles with shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Response USA settles with shareholders.

text.p: Response USA Inc said Monday it has reached formal settlements with all holders of its 1996 Series A convertible preferred stock.

It said the basis for the settlements is consistent with the deal it announced with Halifax Fund LP in May to convert preferred stock and sell underlying common stock to certain unaffiliated purchasers.

As previously announced, Halifax filed a suit against Reponse in February challenging its decision to suspend conversion and seeking specific performance of the certificate of designation provisions concerning stock conversion.
As part of the settlement, all litigation relating to the 1996 series A convertible preferred stock will be dismissed.
